changes: Generate journal opens centered and closes immediately while retaining its draft. Late calculations cannot update a closed or reopened window.
Typing replaces the selected template name. Search covers the complete available catalog and saved templates.

Added chart-backed templates for supported expenses, fees, income, financial support, salary accrual and withholding, balance payments, transfers and currency exchanges. Existing template edits, numbers and removals are retained.
Manual journal details can match a template and fill its missing lines. Ambiguous choices remain visible for selection; amounts and tax allocations are not guessed.
